title: Ecuador: Unit Review
goal: Review the highlands, the Galápagos, the indigenous movement, the 2008 constitution and Yasuní, with the grammar you used to talk about them.
grammar: review: relative clauses, the ser passive, retelling with time and place words, el hecho de que, si bien

items: I can review what I learned about Ecuador, from the volcanoes to Yasuní.
I can use relative clauses, the passive with *ser*, retelling words, *el hecho de que* and *si bien*.
I can put events from 1802 to 2023 in order.
I can say who says what when a matter is disputed.
I can describe a place with a relative clause (*que*, *quien*).
I can say what was done to a place with the passive (*fue declarado*).
I can retell what someone said, shifting the time and place words.
I can comment on a fact with *el hecho de que* + subjunctive.
I can grant a point formally with *si bien* + indicative (review).
